build_ViT_model: build a Vision Transformer model for image classification with configurable patch size, depth, and heads
create_Attention_module: create a multi-head self-attention module with optional masking for transformer architectures
build_Transformer_encoder: build a Transformer encoder stack with residual connections and pre-normalization layers
create_FeedForward_module: create a feed-forward neural network module with GELU activation and configurable dropout
build_Residual_PreNorm_wrapper: build a Residual or PreNorm wrapper module to add skip connections and layer normalization
